_comment: Phase-1 shared aircraft/task set for genome/ and evolution/ (2026-10-06). Single source of truth for trim points, envelope, controller limits, task definition, fitness weights and pitch/altitude gain bounds. genome/ reads it through profiles.load_profile + adapter (presets with "shared": "phase1"); export_shared_profiles.py writes the equivalent Evolution Runner profile block. Rationale per field: ALIGNMENT.md. Physical aircraft data (mass, inertia, geometry, derivatives) stays in aircraft_profiles/<name>.json.

task.aircraft_root: flight-dynamics/jsbsim_root (FD prepare_aircraft copies; network I/O stripped at the source by FD, and any aircraft file declaring network I/O is refused on load)

heading_hold._why: Phase 1 (2026-10-06): c172x drifted ~25 deg in heading on every seed (prop torque + P-only wing leveller -> standing ~1.5 deg bank). Outer loop heading error -> bank cmd (PI, clamped to the aircraft's bank_limit_deg) feeding the existing wing leveller (kp_roll/kd_roll fixed, profile-scaled). On for every Phase-1 aircraft that sets heading_hold.enabled; the legacy task never reads this file. See genome/HANDOFF_heading_hold.md.
heading_hold.heading_target: initial heading (psi at t=0, 0 deg true in every scenario)
heading_hold.law: phi_cmd = clip(kp_hdg*e_psi + ki_hdg*I, +-bank_limit_deg); I += e_psi*dt only if ki_hdg > 0, clipped to +-hdg_i_limit_deg/ki_hdg

v5._why: Phase-1 v5 candidate (2026-10-06, after Sim Bridge's replay: flat cost surface, ki_alt at zero on jets, ~17 ft p-p hold oscillation on c172x s1, learning stalls after gen 9). NOT the default: presets opt in with "hold_quality": true / "disturbance_scenario": true (preset phase1_v5). See genome/HANDOFF_phase1_v5.md.

hold_quality.definition: hold windows = stretches where the altitude reference equals the commanded altitude with zero reference rate, minus the first hold_settle_s of each stretch; hold_osc = RMS over all hold samples of (e - mean_window(e)), e = h_cmd - h, divided by hold_ref_ft
hold_quality._weight_why: sweep on c172x seed 1, pop 48x40 (runs/v5_sweep_w*, v5_sweep_report.py): hold_osc 0.526 (v4 genome) -> 0.443 / 0.373 / 0.254 at w = 0.03 / 0.1 / 0.3, calm hold p-p 6.4 -> 5.6 / 3.9 / 3.1 ft; v4-yardstick cost 0.1960 -> 0.1971 / 0.1951 / 0.2228. 0.1 is the largest weight with no loss on the v4 task (0.3 buys its hold quality with +14% v4 cost: more elevator activity and comfort); at 0.1 the hold term is ~18% of the c172x cost. hold_ref_ft 5 = the v4 bests' RMS hold deviation is ~2.6 ft (hold_osc ~0.5) on c172x, ~1.2 ft on the jets

disturbance.kind: sustained downdraft, one extra calm scenario appended to the scenario set (same aggregation as the rest: mean)
disturbance.onset_shape: w = draft * 0.5*(1 - cos(pi*clip((t - onset_t_s)/onset_ramp_s, 0, 1))), added to wind-down-fps (+ = down)
disturbance.scaling: downdraft_fps = V_TAS(trim) * tan(gamma_equiv_deg): the same air-relative flight-path offset (hence the same steady pitch offset an altitude integrator must supply) on every aircraft

heading_hold._bank_limit_why: min(standard-rate (3 deg/s) bank at the trim TAS, 25 deg autopilot convention), rounded down: c172x 16.2 -> 16, T38 43.8 -> 25, 737 38.6 -> 25
heading_hold._gain_bounds_why: genome_schema reference ranges (c172x) x V/V_ref (TAS at trim; turn rate = g tan(phi)/V), 3 significant figures

disturbance._why: V_TAS 179.1 ft/s x tan(1.5 deg) = 1.43 m/s
